verdict.rationale: Foreloop's only documented approval gate sits on the task contract before any work runs; it is not a review of the agent's resulting diff. The docs say the agent does the work and opens a pull request directly, and product reviews happen on the PR afterwards. That is an adjacent control and earns no credit for a pre-PR diff-approval step.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request
